display.purpose: Route-defining reading moments and featured book titles.

body.purpose: Navigation, controls, metadata, and long-form copy.

motion.name: ease-out-authored
motion.purpose: Short cover, filter, and drawer transitions.

narrative.overview: Heo is an optimistic personal publishing system. New routes inherit its shell while developing subject-specific compositions from real content.
keyCharacteristics: Clear blue actions on pale, breathable page fields.
Warm yellow and red used sparingly for emphasis and personality.
Compact controls paired with generous content composition.
Light and dark treatments designed as equal states.

rules.name: Three-Color Rule
rules.body: Blue carries interaction, yellow marks discovery, and red stays a rare accent.

rules.name: Mixed Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif identifies authored reading moments while sans serif handles interface work.

dos: Use real book covers and stable book proportions where available.
Preserve the Heo shell and make route-local expression live inside it.
donts: Do not use nested cards or generic icon-card page scaffolds.
Do not expose private API configuration or fabricate book metadata.
